rule: Read the address card (identity, names, address_roles, behaviour, evidence, judgements, categories, case_judgements, risk), not the labels list.

properties.name: identity
properties.question: identity
properties.means: What the address is: the identity word of the lowest rank.

properties.name: identity_name
properties.question: identity
properties.means: The name the winning identity row gives, such as the exchange id. Absent when the value is empty or repeats the word.

properties.name: identities
properties.question: identity
properties.means: Every identity word of the address, each once, in rank order.

properties.name: address_roles
properties.question: role
properties.means: Every role word of the address, each once, sorted.

properties.name: behaviour
properties.question: behaviour
properties.means: What kind of automated or high-volume account one week of on-chain counts shows. Not a risk.

properties.name: behaviour_week
properties.question: behaviour
properties.means: The last day of the week the behaviour was read for.

properties.name: role_fit
properties.question: role
properties.means: Whether the behaviour fits the address's role: fits, silent (no behaviour) or off_pattern. Absent when no role of the address has a fits list.

properties.name: evidence
properties.question: evidence
properties.means: What the address did or what was done to it: one entry per live row, word:VALUE, or the word alone when the value is empty or repeats the word. Sorted.

properties.name: judgements
properties.question: judgement
properties.means: Risky patterns that do not convict on their own: one entry per live row, word:VALUE. Sorted. A judgement accuses nobody.

properties.name: exposed
properties.question: exposure
properties.means: How close the address sits to a scam kind, one grade below proof: JSON text, an array with one block per scam kind, sorted by scam_kind (band top, high or raised; scam_kind; steps; path; path_address; way; link_payments; link_two_way; day; profile; paid_once). Absent when there is nothing to show. It is never evidence against the address and sets no risk word.

properties.name: risk
properties.question: card
properties.means: The highest level of any live word of the address. Absent when every word is none.

properties.name: names
properties.question: name
properties.means: The names the address is known by, such as its ENS or Basenames name: the value of each live name row, sorted, each once. A name is no judgement. Absent when it has none.

properties.name: categories
properties.question: card
properties.means: Every category of the address's live judgements, sorted, each once: malicious, suspect or victim. Malicious is always a positive, a suspect is never confirmed, a victim lost money. A suspect shows only when no malicious row is live. One address can be a victim in one case and malicious in another. Absent when the address has no judgement.

properties.name: case_judgements
properties.question: card
properties.means: One entry per live judgement with its case, sorted: category|type|role|case. type and role are empty when there is none; for a mule the type is the type of its trail. case is the evidence case of the row, or list:<labeler> for a row of an outside list, which has no case.

properties.name: sources
properties.question: card
properties.means: Who gave the answers on the card, in this order.

properties.name: card_version
properties.question: card
properties.means: The vocabulary version that resolved the card.

properties.name: card_updated_ms
properties.question: card
properties.means: When the labels layer last wrote the card, in epoch milliseconds.
